## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The refresh helper can erase evidence of edits to tracked files. The added tests cover preservation through registration but miss this failure through refresh.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/integrity.py:17 — correctness — With an edited `tracked.txt` and a new `new.txt`, refreshing both names replaces the original tracked digest, causing verification to accept the edited file. Preserve existing digests when refreshing after file additions, as `register_new_files` does. — Hand edits to tracked content become undetectable.

## Suggestions
(none)

## Strengths
- `register_new_files` preserves existing fingerprints; its test checks that verification still rejects edited tracked content and covers duplicate names and empty input.
